tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every surface. Body text uses `fg` on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, inputs, header bars. `fg` and `muted` read on it.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Hover fills, quiet chips, count badges, table header row, skeleton base.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders between sections and around cards.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and button borders, dashed drop zones, unchecked step rings. Prototype value: 1.8:1 on `surface` (2.0:1 dark), below the 3:1 control-border floor; pair it with a label or fill so the control never relies on the border alone.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-2`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, hints, inactive tabs on `surface` and `bg`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one interactive hue: primary buttons, links, selected tab underline, focus ring, running steps.

tokens.name: accent-weak
tokens.usage: Selected rows, info banners, running-step fills. Text on it uses `accent` or `fg`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Ready, done and exists states (always with a ✓ glyph and a word).

tokens.name: ok-weak
tokens.usage: Fill behind `ok` pills and banners.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Needs answer, warnings, likely-check sources, overrides (with ? or ! glyph).

tokens.name: warn-weak
tokens.usage: Fill behind `warn` pills, question cards and warning banners.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Blocking problems, conflicts, failures (with × glyph).

tokens.name: bad-weak
tokens.usage: Fill behind `bad` pills and blocking problem cards.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: New records and processing state (dashed borders, + glyph).

tokens.name: info-weak
tokens.usage: Fill behind `info` pills.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and the evidence viewer.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Dark chrome: the prototype controls bar and photo stages.

tokens.name: bar-fg
tokens.usage: Text on `bar`.

tokens.name: photo-stage
tokens.usage: Letterbox behind photos and crops in viewers and thumbnails, in both themes.

tokens.name: photo-scrim
tokens.usage: Behind labels, ticks and controls drawn over photos, in both themes. Text on it uses `photo-fg`.

tokens.name: photo-fg
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on `photo-stage` or `photo-scrim`, in both themes.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Crop handles, before/after wipe bar and numbered crop badges on photos. Text on it uses `#111` ink.

tokens.name: masthead-ground
tokens.usage: Masthead backdrop behind the electronics current; also the fog colour of the 3D scene.

tokens.name: masthead-dot
tokens.usage: Dot-grid pattern on `masthead-ground` (16px pitch).

tokens.name: part-outline
tokens.usage: Outline ink of every 3D part (`OUTLINE_COLOUR`). At least 3:1 on `masthead-ground` in both themes.

tokens.name: part-crease
tokens.usage: Crease lines inside 3D parts (`CREASE_COLOUR`).

tokens.name: part-base
tokens.usage: Base fill of 3D parts (`BASE_FILL`); dark fill tints are mixed 72% towards the dark value.

tokens.name: dev-fg
tokens.usage: Dev mode badge text on `dev-bg`.

tokens.name: dev-bg
tokens.usage: Dev mode badge fill.

tokens.name: dev-line
tokens.usage: Dev mode badge border.

families.sans: "Public Sans Variable", "Public Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: Masthead wordmark; second word at weight 450.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Group photos that belong together, such as the front and back of one packet.
styles.usage: All running text and form values.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Item titles in lists, capture button labels.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata, hints, counts, field labels at 600.

styles.name: button-lg
styles.sample: Approve 6 items and add to InvenTree

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Part numbers, IPNs, SKUs, date codes, keyboard keys.

spacing.note: Each step is a multiple of 2px: `space-N` is N×2px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline stacks: between a label and its value, tree levels, segment gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside chip and pill rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a toolbar; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between sibling controls and grid tiles.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap in stacks and list rows.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; card grid gap.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: List row and section horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding, page side gutter (minimum).

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Gap between main layout columns; page top padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; one indent level in trees and nested lists.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: App page side padding at desktop width; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Page bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Keyboard keys, matrix cells.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Source chips, inline tags, wipe labels.

tokens.name: radius-thumb
tokens.usage: Thumbnails and crop previews.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, evidence tiles.

tokens.name: radius-btn
tokens.usage: Buttons, option rows, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, banners, groups, question cards.

tokens.name: radius-popover
tokens.usage: Activity popover.

tokens.name: radius-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the evidence viewer.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, chips, filter buttons, the activity indicator.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Round dots and spinners: status dots, phase markers, the autosave spinner.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Only floating layers: sticky approve footer, popovers, dialogs, toasts. Cards use borders, not shadows.

duration.note: How long an interface change takes. Every animation and transition stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover background changes on buttons, rows, chips and tabs (`ease-linear`).

tokens.name: duration-exit
tokens.usage: Popovers and menus closing (`ease-exit`).

tokens.name: duration-enter
tokens.usage: Popovers and menus opening (`ease-enter`); toasts fading out.

tokens.name: duration-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts appearing (`ease-enter`).

tokens.name: duration-spin
tokens.usage: One turn of a running spinner (`ease-linear`).

tokens.name: duration-sweep
tokens.usage: One pass of the skeleton shimmer while a preview prepares (`ease-linear`).

tokens.name: duration-pulse
tokens.usage: One cycle of the running-step pulse, `accent-weak` at 0.6 to 1 opacity (`ease-loop`).

easing.note: Timing curves for the durations above.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus and toasts appearing, and toasts leaving.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Popovers and menus closing.

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: Hover colour changes, spinners and the skeleton shimmer.

tokens.name: ease-loop
tokens.usage: The running-step pulse.

zIndex.note: Stacking layers, lowest to highest. Toasts sit above popovers so a message is never hidden by an open menu.

tokens.name: z-raised
tokens.usage: An element lifted over its siblings inside a card, such as the current step's marker.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, tooltips, the Needs you panel and suggestion lists.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above every popover and dialog.

breakpoint.note: Viewport widths where layouts change. Use as max-width: below the value, the narrower layout applies.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: Phone width: toolbars wrap and secondary actions move into menus.

tokens.name: bp-narrow
tokens.usage: Small tablets: two-up tile grids drop to one column.

tokens.name: bp-compact
tokens.usage: Review becomes list → item; the masthead shortens its status to one word.

tokens.name: bp-stacked
tokens.usage: Two-column pages (Capture, Records) collapse to one column.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: Review drops its evidence pane and keeps list and details.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls, always with a nearby reason.

tokens.name: opacity-muted
tokens.usage: De-emphasised but still active content, such as retired lots and superseded values.

size.note: Fixed sizes for controls, targets, glyph icons, focus rings and motion distance.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs, selects and segmented controls.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target at phone width; small controls grow their hit area to it.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Glyph icons inside pills, chips and table rows.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Glyph icons beside titles and in buttons.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Glyph icons in empty states, capture actions and the masthead.

tokens.name: ring-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring width: a solid `accent` outline on every interactive element.

tokens.name: ring-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between an element and its focus ring.

tokens.name: offset-enter
tokens.usage: How far a popover or menu travels as it opens and closes.

tokens.name: offset-toast
tokens.usage: How far a toast rises as it appears; it leaves by fading only.

tokens.name: width-content
tokens.usage: Maximum width of main content, centred, on every page except Review and Records.

tokens.name: width-review
tokens.usage: Maximum width of Review and Records, which need three panes.

meta.note: Values from the Bench Intake prototype artifact (SMeLiqLkdW7J1ijj8T7dni) and the masthead in frontend/src/components/masthead and frontend/src/electronics-current/finishes.ts. Copied into frontend/src/theme/tokens.json with the PR-A additions (photo-scrim, photo-fg, dark part-* values, the Public Sans Variable stack). Version 2 adds spacing 2/20/24px, radius-round, and duration, easing, zIndex, breakpoint, opacity and size families, from an audit of the values the app already uses. Version 3 renames the spacing scale to a 2px unit (space-N is N×2px), removing the fractional names; values are unchanged.
